Title: Join ZCMC button leads to the job list
Description: Verify the Join ZCMC button opens the job list
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Scroll to the 'Ready to Start Your Journey?' section
3. Click 'Join ZCMC'
Expected results: The Browse Open Positions page (/jobs) opens

Title: Hero Browse Jobs button leads to the job list
Description: Verify the hero Browse Jobs button opens the job list
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Click 'Browse Jobs' in the top section
Expected results: The Browse Open Positions page (/jobs) opens

Title: View All Open Positions button leads to the job list
Description: Verify the button opens the job list
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Scroll to Open Positions
3. Click 'View All Open Positions'
Expected results: The Browse Open Positions page (/jobs) opens

Title: Hero About ZCMC button opens the ZCMC profile page
Description: Verify the About ZCMC button leads to the ZCMC DOH profile page
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Click 'About ZCMC' in the top section
Expected results: The ZCMC DOH profile page (https://zcmc.doh.gov.ph/profile/) opens
Notes: Playwright: landing-buttons.spec.ts. External site: only the address is checked. It may open in the same tab or a new tab

Title: Header Home link returns to the landing page
Description: Verify the Home link in the header
Expected results: The landing page opens with the heading 'Build Our Future with ZCMC'

Title: Header Jobs link opens the job list
Description: Verify the Jobs link in the header
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Click 'Jobs' in the header
Expected results: The Browse Open Positions page (/jobs) opens

Title: Header Login link opens the login page
Description: Verify the Login link in the header
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Click 'Login' in the header
Expected results: The login page (/login) opens with the heading 'Welcome Back'

Title: Footer Browse Jobs link opens the job list
Description: Verify the Browse Jobs link in the footer
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Scroll to the footer
3. Click 'Browse Jobs' under Quick Links
Expected results: The Browse Open Positions page opens
Notes: Playwright: landing-buttons.spec.ts. The link goes to /Jobs (capital J) while the header uses /jobs

Title: Footer About Us and Contact Us links point to the ZCMC DOH site
Test steps:
1. Open the landing page
2. Scroll to the footer
3. Check the About Us and Contact Us links
Expected results: About Us points to https://zcmc.doh.gov.ph/profile/ and Contact Us points to https://zcmc.doh.gov.ph/about-us/
Notes: Playwright: landing-buttons.spec.ts. Only the link addresses are checked. The external pages are not opened
